correctness.rationale: Exact PL orbit-barycenter identification follows because every fixed barycentric point has coefficients constant on two-vertex orbits; at scale two the orbit compatibility graph has differences (1,0) and (1,e_i), which form a basis of F_2^(n-1). The coordinate transform sends it to the cube graph. Its integral cycle rank is (n-3)2^(n-2)+1. Every elementary square of this graph bounds an explicit integral 2-chain of 2 or 4 triangles at scale three, so H_1 at two maps to zero. The C_1-module is the sum of edge stabilizer sign-inductions and C_0 is regular; the connected-graph exact sequence gives the complete character multiplicities. The standalone checker exhaustively verified dimensions n=2,...,7, 27 support cases and 1,404 cube-square fillings. Uniform proof covers all n>=2; no unproved all-dimension enumeration is invoked.

value.rationale: The two-bit translation is a natural conjugacy class of the cube automorphism group, distinct from a single flip and coordinate permutations. Its scale-two fixed locus has exponentially large free pi_1 even when the ambient complex is simply connected; the exact integral vanishing of all classes at scale three supplies persistent information, and the centralizer character decomposition contains finer symmetry data. This is an infinite structural classification with a motivated sharp Hamming-weight boundary, not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere known Betti-number recomputation.
